description: This is a test source file for the DownloadFormat class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It contains a unit test class that verifies the behavior of JSON download formats for employee data, including setup procedures and assertions for filename generation.

classes.name: DownloadFormatTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing JSON download filename generation in the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, particularly instantiating the JsonDownloadFormat object and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testDownloadFileName
methods.description: Asserts that the generated download filenames match expected values for given employee IDs.
